notes.title: Version 2.0!
notes.content:
[h1]Multiple controller support![/h1]
[list]
[*] Now there's an additional screen for syncing your controllers and choosing the right button icons / glyphs
[*] You can still just use one controller as before! Just sync one controller then press A to continue to Settings.
[*] Settings menu has been squeezed into the whole screen now that glyph selection has moved to its own screen.
[/list]
[h2] Supported controllers[/h2]
[list]
[*] Valve Steam Controller
[*] Steam Deck's built-in gamepad
[*] Xbox - separate 360 and One/Series glyphs)
[*] PlayStation (all PlayStation controllers including uDraw tablet have been consolidated to this option)
[*] Nintendo Switch Pro
[*] NES*
[*] SNES* - choose between JP/PAL and US colo(u)rs!
[*] N64*
[*] GameCube (via 8Bitdo GBros adapter - ensure it's switched to X mode!)
[*] Wii Nunchuck (plugged into 8Bitdo GBros adapter - works the same in S and X switch mode)
[/list]* NES SNES and N64 controller glyph placement is based on the Nintendo Online editions of these controllers, so may not work well for the original controllers...
[h1] Misc. changes[/h1]
[list][*]Slightly moved the cup on the [spoiler]normal[/spoiler] title logo.
[*] Pressing Esc no longer quits the game and is instead a 'cancel' button.
[*] Consequently, Autosave is now off by default Edit config.txt to re-enable it!
[/list]
Edit 8th Dec 2024: New hotfix: run the new exe! file size doubled because both versions of Ninja Numpties are installed. oops :(

notes.title: Controls revamp and player number QoL update
notes.content:
[h1]Gamepad improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Gamepad: press Select/View/etc. to toggle the Help Menu
[*] Trap Menu: now you can also close the Boobytrap Menu with X/Square button
[*] Skip hop is now on A/X button which is much more diegetic
[*] Keyboard: extra buttons
[/list]
[h1]Keyboard Controls Revamp[/h1]
[list]
[*] E: Open/Close Boobytrap Menu
[*] Space: Select menu option, Skip Hop
[*] Previous control scheme still functions like before, i.e. Ctrl and Backspace* for opening/closing Trap Menu respectively.
[*] *Skip Hop is now on Space instead of backspace since it felt more natural and prevents the accidental hopping immediately after closing the Trap Menu
[/list]
[h1]Player numbering revamp[/h1]
[list]
[*] Offshore and general GUI: Player number are actually numbers now instead of tiny dots!
[*] Player number above ninja bonces are just the dots now, so you can see the traps on the floor more clearly and still see "who's who" at a glance like before.
[/list]
